## Definition
The tradeoff between thermodynamic efficiency and computational accuracy in quantum reservoir computing, where dissipation affects memory and nonlinearity. Guides the design of energy-constrained TCC nodes and iNEST devices, balancing performance with thermal budgets in network environments.
